1879073116.name: Resonant Piercing Cry
1879073116.desc: Your shout does light damage to your enemies and can interrupt their actions.

1879085148.name: Slice (Rank 3)
1879085148.desc: A sweeping cut that can damage multiple targets in front of the attacker.

1879176284.name: Muster in Mirk-eaves
1879176284.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Mirk-eaves in Mirkwood.

1879191772.name: Skeleton Painted Horse
1879191772.desc: A horse painted in a festive, if frightening, visage to help celebrate Bilbo's Haunted Burrow in Hobbiton.

1879198300.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879199196.name: Rally!

1879213148.name: Improved Whirling Retaliation
1879213148.desc: After parrying, whirl to attack enemies in a circle.\nDraws threat from all Fellowship members within 10 metres.

1879215964.desc: This is a fleet-footed goat capable of achieving speeds as great as truly fast horses.

1879216860.name: Split Shot

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

 <rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline focuses on the Captain's ability to lead as the vanguard on the battlefield. This enhances their ability to command a battlefield and direct combat to their desire.

1879244252.name: Jollification
1879244252.desc: The Burglar takes great joy in wreaking havoc amongst their enemies.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879252700.name: Break Free
1879252700.desc: With great ardour you spur your steed onward, breaking it free of its bonds. Your steed is provided with immunity to such effects for a short period of time.

1879263324.name: Strength of Champions
1879263324.desc: Known to many as ferocious warriors, your mere presence strengthens your allies

1879302620.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Swordswoman)
1879302620.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879316060.name: Bee Swarm
1879316060.desc: Unleashes bees on the target, dealing damage over time.

1879341276.name: Steed of Winter's Light
1879341276.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879378140.name: Grey Mountains Elite Goat
1879378140.desc: An elite goat belonging to the Grey Mountains Expedition.

1879405404.name: Woodland Rabbit
1879405404.desc: Summons a grey rabbit to keep you company.

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus to steeling yourself against the enemy's attack, drawing their ire and defending your allies from enemy assaults.

1879493468.name: Ghostly Cat
1879493468.desc: Summons a ghostly cat to help you celebrate the season.

1879497692.name: Major Pet Command
1879497692.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879507676.name: Sea-side Kite
1879507676.desc: Brings out a kite for you to fly in the sea breeze.

1879508572.name: Poisonous Grodbog Protector
1879508572.desc: Summons a poisonous grodbog protector to accompany you on your travels.

1879521244.name: Overgrown Boglurker
1879521244.desc: Summons an overgrown boglurker to accompany you on your travels.

1879527388.name: Broken Chain
1879527388.desc: Channel the power of broken chain to create a zone of protection against some of Thothrach's attacks. This power will also harm the user.
